project.description:
The project aims to describe and analyse Latvia's religious landscape by collecting and reviewing various theoretical and empirical sources. Using an interdisciplinary ex-ante theory-building approach, it will develop a theoretical framework for future studies of the religious landscape and its changes.
It will provide insight into Latvia's multifaceted religious identity, revealing its previously overlooked profile dimensions. The research results will help understand the dynamics of the religious life of Latvian society, its transformation, and its impact on other areas of society's life.
project.title: Theoretical Aspects of Researching the Religious Landscape of Modern Latvia
